    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("white car")
    curb_patches = image_patch.find("curb")
    
    if not cars or not curb_patches:
        return []
    
    curb_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in curb_patches]
    car_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in cars]
    
    left_cars = [car for car in cars if min(car_centers) < min(curb_centers)]
    right_cars = [car for car in cars if max(car_centers) > max(curb_centers)]
    
    return left_cars + right_cars
